skill.name: pollinations-ai
skill.description: Generate and save images using the free Pollinations.ai API. The skill covers prompt structure, URL parameters, Python downloads, batch variants, and metadata tracking.
skill.summary: Create Pollinations.ai images from prompts, parameters, seeds, and batch workflows.
skill.author: supercent-io

security_audit.summary: The static external-command and path-traversal alerts are mostly false positives from Markdown backticks and related-skill links. The real risks are intended network calls to Pollinations.ai and local file writes from examples that save images and metadata. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Tell users that prompts and URL parameters are sent to Pollinations.ai. Avoid sensitive content and get consent for client assets.
Constrain output_file to a project assets directory. Reject absolute paths and parent-directory segments before writing files.
Avoid bash -c for generated scripts. Prefer reviewed commands and explicit user confirmation before execution.
Do not store confidential prompts in generation_metadata.json unless the user requests persistent metadata.

content.value_statement: Teams need fast concept images without paid accounts or complex setup. This skill guides prompt creation, URL generation, batch variants, and local saving through Pollinations.ai.
actual_capabilities: Explains Pollinations.ai URL construction with width, height, model, seed, nologo, and enhance parameters.
Provides Python examples that request generated images and save response content.
Shows batch generation patterns for prompt lists and seeded variants.
Documents metadata capture for prompt, model, dimensions, seed, output file, and timestamp.
Includes troubleshooting guidance for aspect ratios, colors, retries, and reproducibility.
limitations: Generated prompts are sent to a third-party service.
Image quality and model availability depend on Pollinations.ai.
Example scripts need local path review before writing files.

use_cases.title: Prototype Visuals
use_cases.description: Create placeholder hero images, thumbnails, and layout assets before final design work starts.

use_cases.title: Draft Marketing Assets
use_cases.description: Generate banner and social media concepts with target dimensions and style constraints.

use_cases.title: Explore Creative Variants
use_cases.description: Produce several prompt and seed variations for quick comparison in automated workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Single Image Prompt
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one image idea.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft a Pollinations.ai prompt for a clean website hero image about [topic]. Include style, lighting, mood, and composition.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Sized Asset
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a Pollinations.ai URL for [asset type]. Set width to [width], height to [height], model to flux, and seed to [seed].

prompt_templates.title: Build Variations With Seeds
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan four image variants for [campaign]. Keep the base prompt consistent, change seeds, and describe expected differences.

prompt_templates.title: Automate Batch Image Production
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with files and metadata.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a reviewed batch workflow for [image set]. Include prompts, dimensions, safe output paths, seeds, and metadata fields.

output_examples.input: A request for a SaaS website hero image at 1920 by 1080 pixels.
output_examples.output: A polished prompt, selected model, dimensions, seed guidance, and a Pollinations.ai generation URL.

output_examples.input: A request for four social banner concepts with consistent brand colors.
output_examples.output: Four prompt variants with matching dimensions, recommended seeds, and notes for comparing visual direction.

output_examples.input: A request to document generated files for later reuse.
output_examples.output: A concise generation report listing prompt, model, dimensions, seed, selected image, and usage notes.

best_practices: Describe subject, style, lighting, mood, composition, and quality details in each prompt.
Choose dimensions before generation to match the final placement.
Use seeds and metadata when repeatable image results matter.
anti_patterns: Do not send confidential client prompts or private assets to the public API.
Do not write output files to absolute paths or parent directories without review.
Do not rely on vague prompts when brand, composition, or aspect ratio matters.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Pollinations.ai account?
faq.answer: No. The skill describes URL-based image generation without an API key.

faq.question: Can it generate images with fixed dimensions?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents width and height parameters for common asset sizes.

faq.question: Can it make repeatable images?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends using a seed with the same prompt and parameters.

faq.question: Where are generated images saved?
faq.answer: The examples save files to local paths chosen in the workflow. Review paths before writing.

faq.question: Is prompt data sent outside my environment?
faq.answer: Yes. Prompts and parameters are sent to Pollinations.ai when generation URLs are requested.

faq.question: Can this replace full design review?
faq.answer: No. It helps draft images, but users must review quality, rights, and brand fit.
